name: ReelsFarm
original_description: ReelsFarm helps content creators and marketing teams make social media images, short videos, and slideshows. Create AI avatar images and product photos, assemble videos from saved media, and revise slideshow drafts. Recreate a public TikTok photo slideshow for your product as a draft. Organize completed content and prepare it for connected social accounts. Review the proposed action before it runs in Review mode. A ReelsFarm account is required. Publishing requires a connected social account and the platform's required settings.
